title: Worker byte vector spare capacity
summary: Recover the 0x519d50 thiscall capacity check and 1.5x growth calculation using the three 32-bit vector pointers. The caller at 0x5c20e0 uses it before appending a byte; growth delegates to the original reallocation dependency at 0x51a450.
test_description: Direct original comparisons cover zero, equal and smaller requests across ordinary and wrapping 32-bit pointer values, checking all fields, guard words and FS head. Controlled callbacks exercise geometric growth, required capacity, overflow and error dispatch, and check the receiver, argument and untouched fields.
known_limits: The original growth path requires the separate reallocation routine and CRT allocation, memmove and delete imports; no trusted test bindings for those imports are provided, so growth is checked with a dependency spy rather than direct original execution.

The original length-error import receives its fixed message and normally does not return; the integration hook represents that non-returning operation and the test double returns only to observe subsequent arithmetic.
32-bit address arithmetic and valid vector invariants are assumed by the original; allocation failure and exception unwinding are not tested.
